text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Nice running, me! I must have
captivated over
ten-thousand people
with today's performance.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I can already see it! The swarm of
reporters
descending upon me like a
meteor shower,
lauding me as best
newcomer.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, dear reporters, the day is here!
Interview me
to your heart's content!
Silence...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: What? An empty house? No!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Um... Opera O? Do you have a moment
for some
questions?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Only one person?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I'm here, too...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: You looked amazing out there, Opera O.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And Doto?! It... it wasn't supposed to be
like
this...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! What on earth is happening
here?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Not that famous... So, not even the top
reporters
of the age have taken notice
of my existence?
choice_data_list: あまり有名じゃないから……

text_block_list.text:
Hardly any Umamusume become a hot
topic right
after their debut.

For the first time, Opera O faces the
wall known
as reality...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha! That is fine! It only proves I have taken a step forward.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A grand total of zero reporters had ever
come to
interview me before today.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But now, zero has become one! That is far more difficult than turning one into ten.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Thus, the curtain has, without a doubt,
been
raised for the legend of the
Centurial Overlord!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Just a small twinkle of my brilliance has
been
seen, but I am fully satisfied.
Haaah ha ha ha!

She just can't see it. So much for the wall
of
reality.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
With this spectacular debut under my
belt, why
don't we move on toward my
next
accomplishment?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer! What is my next
objective?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
No, no. Forget about races for a
moment. I want
to focus on increasing
the number of reporters I
attract.
choice_data_list: えーと、次の目標レースは……

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I must rescue the poor masses stuck in
the abyss
of despair that is not knowing
my existence.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Have you any words of wisdom? How
can we go
about attracting more
reporters?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Fans?
choice_data_list: まずは……ファンを増やすとか？

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes... More fans will result in more
reporters,
just as more reporters will
result in more fans...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What came first, the chicken or the egg?
Or was
it me?! I came first, then the egg!
It all lines up!

I don't follow, but she seems to accept
my
suggestion.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It is settled. Our first order of business is
to
increase my fandom. And to increase
fans, one
must...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Race! Join this race and then that
race—every
race available, even if it
means merely one more
fan!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Doto! Let us be off! Haaah ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: C-coming!

Turning on her heel, T.M. Opera O starts
walking
to... who knows where.

I guess she's just riding her excitement.
Certainly
she'll be waiting for me right
outside the venue.
